issues.where: under the foreground creature's feeding tendrils in the left crop (also visible in set-A-07.png center and behind the running creature on the left)
issues.what: water spray and drips render as opaque milky-white stretched oval dots hovering in midair above flat painted-looking white ripple rings
issues.fix: replace opaque droplet sprites with refractive, motion-blurred liquid drips and physically displaced water ripples

issues.where: foreground water meeting the dark rocks in the bottom-right crop (also visible at bottom-left of set-A-07.png)
issues.what: the water surface cuts across the rocks as a glassy, semi-transparent sheet with hard polygonal edges and no foam or wet-rock transition
issues.fix: conform the water mesh to the rock geometry with a darkened wet band, meniscus, and subtle foam along the contact line

issues.where: the small pale scavenger perched on the upper ridge of the carcass in the top-right crop (also visible in set-A-04.png)
issues.what: the scavenger has two distinct glossy black eyes with white specular highlights, violating the no-eyes rule, and reads as a smooth sculpted CG model
issues.fix: remove the eyes completely and add fine organic surface variation and wet residue matching the cliff

issues.where: the foreground pebble shore across both crops (also visible at bottom-right of set-A-01.png)
issues.what: the gravel beach is a flat 2D texture plane with smeared, squashed pebbles and almost no 3D relief at grazing angles
issues.fix: replace the flat ground texture with true geometric displacement and scattered 3D pebbles and wet silt in the foreground

issues.where: the dark cliff face behind the carcass in the top-left crop (also visible on the left of set-A-01.png)
issues.what: the rock texture is heavily stretched, wavy, and pinched horizontally, reading like melted plastic or distorted UV noise
issues.fix: reproject or triplanar-map high-resolution fractured rock detail with crisp micro-displacement and matte mineral variation

issues.where: the hanging seaweed strands and carcass legs in the left crop (also visible in set-A-04.png)
issues.what: the kelp strips look like stiff, paper-thin polygonal ribbons with faceted kinks, and the carcass skin looks like soft sculpted clay with repetitive noise
issues.fix: give the seaweed organic thickness, translucency, and limp contact against the wet rock, and add fibrous decay and wet sheen to the carcass

issues.where: the two dark boulders sitting in the water at the bottom-right
issues.what: a bright, hard-edged halo seam outlines the boulders where they intersect the water plane, with stretched stripey rock texture and no wet waterline
issues.fix: eliminate the intersection halo, darken the wet lower rock, and add natural water-line reflections and foam

issues.where: the legs and bodies of the foreground and midground wading creatures
issues.what: the legs poke into the water like dry sticks with no wet darkening, no ripples around the ankles, and a uniform dry sculpted parchment look with nothing of the wet coast on them
issues.fix: darken and gloss the lower legs where wet, add small ripples and meniscus at each entry point, and vary skin roughness and translucency

issues.where: the scattered wading creatures across the midground flats
issues.what: several creatures share stiff, nearly identical poses and lack convincing shadows, reflections, or water disturbance where their feet touch the surface
issues.fix: vary creature poses and add grounded contact shadows, wet reflections, and ripples in the shallow water

issues.where: the distant curved rock spires and sky in the top-right crop
issues.what: the spire silhouette shows slight polygonal faceting with repetitive procedural banding, and distant flying birds read as soft dark smudges
issues.fix: subdivide the spire silhouette, break up the repetitive horizontal striations, and give distant birds crisp wing silhouettes

issues.where: the foreground creature's wingtip in the bottom-left crop
issues.what: the wingtip shows a slightly faceted mesh edge and pinched cutout hole with a clay-like shader at native size
issues.fix: smooth the wingtip geometry and add fine translucent membrane and vein detail
